name: Toyota Logistics Services Vehicle Distribution Center - Portland OR

fieldNotes.facilityType: Port of Portland Terminal 4 vehicle distribution center operated by Toyota Logistics Services. ~101,000 sf VDC building; Toyota has handled vehicles here since 1971, >10,000 vehicles/month. Vehicles arrive by ro/ro ship at the Terminal 4 wharf and by auto-rack rail and leave on auto-hauler trucks.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Facility is enclosed within the Port of Portland Terminal 4 secure area with chain-link perimeter and internal fencing visible in z19-z21 satellite. Maritime port facility — controlled gated entry. The access road off N Lombard St runs into the property as a wide multi-lane apron with stop markings; a small standalone gatehouse-type building sits at the NW corner of the operational yard.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Inferred true. A small standalone building with its own short-side footprint sits beside the internal yard entrance at the NW; consistent with a gatehouse. Port facilities are credentialed/staffed at the gate. Could not unambiguously confirm a discrete booth at the road edge; medium confidence.
fieldNotes.railServed: Confirmed — auto-rack rail tracks run into and through the yard; rail cars / covered rail-side structures visible in z20 imagery. TLS uses rail for inland vehicle distribution from Terminal 4.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: VDC building is a vehicle-processing building, not a classic cross-dock. A small number of dock/grade doors for parts and accessory work; banded 0-10. Atypical metric for this facility type.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large vehicle marshalling lots fill the N and E of the site; striped lots holding finished vehicles. Auto-hauler / trailer drop capacity moderate; banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Entrance apron off N Lombard is deep and multi-lane — room for a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entrance apron with unused paved width gives room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Entrance apron is set well back from N Lombard with a deep throat; a queue would not immediately spill onto the public road. False.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified. Left false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box ~48 acres covering the TLS-operated VDC building and vehicle lots within Terminal 4; the broader Terminal 4 also hosts container/other operations not part of the Toyota lease.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Within the Portland metro industrial waterfront (Rivergate / Terminal 4); classified Urban.
